overrides.browser_navigate: Open a URL in the shared page.
overrides.browser_snapshot: Accessibility tree with element uids. Take one before clicking anything.
overrides.browser_click: Click an element: pass uid from the last snapshot (or a CSS selector).
overrides.browser_drag: Drag from one element to another.
overrides.browser_type: Type into an element. submit=true presses Enter afterwards.
overrides.browser_press_sequentially: Type a string key by key, optionally with a delay.
overrides.browser_select_option: Choose one or more options in a select.
overrides.browser_fill_form: Fill several fields in one call.
overrides.browser_take_screenshot: Screenshot of the page or one element (png/jpeg). filePath saves it to disk.
overrides.browser_evaluate: Evaluate a JavaScript function in the page and return its JSON result.
overrides.browser_run_code_unsafe: Run a Playwright snippet against the page. Powerful and unsafe: it can do anything the browser can.
overrides.browser_find: Search the accessibility snapshot for text or a regular expression; returns matching nodes with refs.
overrides.browser_console_messages: Console messages. onlyErrors hides info/log; pattern filters them.
overrides.browser_network_requests: Requests made since load, as a numbered list. filter is a URL regex.
overrides.browser_network_request: Full headers and body of one request, by the number from browser_network_requests.
overrides.browser_wait_for: Wait for text to appear or disappear, or for N seconds.
overrides.browser_tabs: List, open, close or select tabs.
overrides.browser_file_upload: Upload files into a file input.
overrides.browser_drop: Drop files or MIME data onto an element.
overrides.browser_generate_locator: Suggest a locator for a test from an element ref.
overrides.browser_cookie_list: List cookies for the current context.
overrides.browser_highlight: Highlight an element on the page.
overrides.browser_annotate: Draw annotations on the page and screenshot them.
